The Science Behind Grainary

Why aged rice is different

When rice is aged 12–24 months, starch molecules crystallise, moisture drops below 10%, and the glycemic index falls significantly. No one in Bangalore was telling this story. Grainary does.

FAQ

Common questions

Our Diet Rice (Low GI) has a tested glycemic index of 54, which is classified as LOW GI (below 55). Regular white rice typically scores 70–72. A lower GI means slower glucose release and a smaller insulin spike. We recommend consulting your dietitian, but our product is designed for diabetic-safe meal planning.
